name: change_city_loyalty
description: Add or subtract loyalty in a city (any player's) via City:ChangeLoyalty in GameCore_Tuner (Firaxis Debug/City.ltp '+10 Loyalty'). Use to stop a city flipping, or to push a rival city toward revolt. Params: cityId (required), delta (required, e.g. 10 or -10), playerId (city owner; default local player). GameCore has no loyalty getter, so this returns only the applied delta; read the resulting value in InGame with City:GetCulturalIdentity():GetLoyalty() (loyalty is capped at 100).
lua:
local pid = P.playerId
if pid == nil then pid = Game.GetLocalPlayer() end
local alive = false
for _, id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if id == pid then alive = true end end
if not alive then emitJson({ok=false, error="player "..tostring(pid).." is not alive"}) return end
local c = Players[pid]:GetCities():FindID(P.cityId)
if c == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="city "..tostring(P.cityId).." not found for player "..pid}) return end
if c.ChangeLoyalty == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="City:ChangeLoyalty not available"}) return end
local d = tonumber(P.delta)
if d == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="delta must be a number"}) return end
c:ChangeLoyalty(d)
emitJson({ok=true, cityId=P.cityId, city=c:GetName(), ownerId=pid, appliedDelta=d, note="read the new value in InGame: City:GetCulturalIdentity():GetLoyalty()"})
